title: Legitimate Interest Assessment for Cold Email: 3 Tests, 1 Gate
meta_description: Fully in force since February 2026, the UK GDPR lists direct marketing as a possible legitimate interest. An LIA records 3 tests; PECR may still need consent.

image.takeaway: An LIA has three tests. Where PECR requires consent for an email, legitimate interests cannot be the basis.
image.alt: Legitimate interest assessment for cold email: the purpose, necessity and balancing tests, and the PECR consent rule that decides first whether legitimate interests can be the lawful basis for the email
